title: Learn Colors with Pip! Red Blue Green 🎨 Kids Song
script: Hi friends! Let's learn colors with Pip! / Red apple, look so bright! / Blue star, shining light! / Green sun, oh what fun! / Yay! Let's sing it again!

title: Learn to Count 1 to 3 with Momo! 🎈 BoomBoo Kids
script: Let's count balloons with Momo! / One red balloon up high! / Two blue balloons fly by! / Three yellow balloons we see! / Yay! Count again with me!

title: Learn to Count 1 to 5 with Pip! 🎈 Kids Song
script: Let's count balloons with Pip! / One, two, three red balloons! / Four, five, so much fun! / We can count them all! / Yay! Let's do it again!

title: Learn Shapes with Pip! Circle Star Heart 🌟 Kids Song
script: Hi friends! Let's find shapes with Pip! / Look at the red circle! / See the blue star! / Here is a pink heart! / Yay! Let's do it again!

title: Itsy Bitsy Spider! Nursery Rhyme with Pip | BoomBoo Kids Song
script: Let's sing Itsy Bitsy Spider with Pip! / The itsy bitsy spider climbed up. / Down came the rain. / Out came the sun. / Yay! Pip sang the song!
